text:
Predicates:
ProfessionalWrestlingStable(x) ::: x is a professional wrestling stable.
Leader(x, y) ::: x leads y.
FormedIn(x, y) ::: x is formed in y.
Includes(x, y) ::: x includes y.
Feud(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Premises:
ProfessionalWrestlingStable(diamondMine) ::: Diamond Mine is a professional wrestling stable.
FormedIn(diamondMine, wwe) ::: Diamond Mine is formed in WWE.
Leader(roderickStrong, diamondMine) ::: Roderick Strong leads Diamond Mine.
Includes(diamondMine, creedBrothers) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers.
Includes(diamondMine, ivyNile) ::: Diamond Mine includes Ivy Nile.
Feud(imperium, diamondMine) ::: Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
ProfessionalWrestlingStable(diamondMine) ∧ Leader(roderickStrong, diamondMine) ::: Roderick strong leads a professional wrestling stable.
